# 1. Requirements

This documentation is for accim {{ version }}.

To use accim, the following must be installed:

*   Python 3.9 or newer.
    *   On Windows, when installing it, tick the checkbox "Add python.exe to PATH".
    *   At the end of the installation, click on "Disable path length limit": the names of the files generated by accim can be long (see {doc}`5_troubleshooting`).
*   EnergyPlus (any version between 9.1 and 25.2, inclusive) in its default folder (e.g., `C:\EnergyPlusV25-2-0`). accim reads each IDF with the EnergyPlus version of the file, so the versions of your models must be installed, or the models updated to an installed version (see {doc}`5_troubleshooting`).

accim is developed and tested on Windows.

Jupyter Notebook is also recommended to run the example notebooks located in `accim/sample_files/jupyter_notebooks`. These sample files are only installed with `pip install "accim[samples]"` (see {ref}`running-example-notebooks`).
